provinceDeepAtlasProfile.oneLine: Virelport is centered at 74.860836, 82.978230 under City-State League, with 41,250,000 people across 9 settlements.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.extremeAtlasDescription: Virelport occupies 3,416,648.08 sq mi / 8,849,077.91 sq km of modeled Earth-sized territory, about 1.734889% of Belavadös's surface. It is not merely a province but a continent-scale civic machine: Beach and grass with water, Beach and reefs with water and Partial forest define its broad terrain, while its settlements intensify into Beach and grass with water, Partial forest, Deep cavern, Beach and reefs with water and Underwater without reefs. Population density is 4.662 people/sq km / 12.073 people/sq mi, which lets wilderness, roads, faction-held corridors, and vast uncrowded borders remain huge.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.peopleFactionsAndFaith: The strongest public people-groups are Humans, Near-Humans, and Mixed Heritage, Halfling and Smallfolk, Animalfolk and Mammalian Anthropomorphs, Amphibious and Aquatic Peoples, Draconic and Reptilian Races, Elemental and Energy-Born Peoples, and 2 more. Frequently recorded peoples include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Elf — Sea Elf, Tortle, Genasi — Water Genasi, Triton, Merfolk, Locathah, and 4 more. Faction visibility leans toward The Crucible Wardens, with worship and patronage records naming Marduthor, Setrimir, Nebyrr, Ishtanora, Iskareth, Bastveig, Valkhamesh, and 3 more.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.groupLinkDescription: The province participates in 25 recorded four-province geography group links, including 22 cross-transportation-group links. These links place it inside overlapping regional corridors rather than one isolated block, allowing border-adjacent transit, faction influence, and cultural spillover to breathe across group lines.

npcs.name: Faradai Coil
npcs.description: Faradai Coil is a Gnome archivist engineer who keeps the Stormgullet Workshop running with solder burns, sleepless notes, and the brittle patience of someone surrounded by people who think ideals repair machinery. He maintains old refuge systems, power relays, memory devices, and transit safeguards for the Choral Synod, often acting as the practical counterweight to philosophers and fugitives. Faradai is loyal, irritable, and afraid that one failed mechanism will expose every protected person he ever promised to keep hidden.
npcs.settlementAndAncestryTexture: Stormgullet is a City in Virelport, under City-State League, with high danger, Partial forest, Beach and grass with water, Deep forest terrain. Local records favor Altruistic, Neutral, Cooperative, Honorable civic habits; common communities include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Elf — Wood Elf, Elf — Eladrin, Fey-Folk — Faerie. Gnome reads through the Deep Gnome entry of the race compendium, within Dwarven and Gnomish Kin, marked by Marduthor. Deep gnomes, or svirfneblin, are adapted to life in the deep subterranean world. They are cautious, stealthy, and highly resourceful in dangerous underground environments. Table cues: Gnome, Darkvision, Gift of the Svirfneblin, Gnomish Magic Resistance; starting tendency Neutral - Lawful - Neutral - Honorable.
rumors: Faradai Coil knows why an ichor ledger changed hands last Valkhaday.
Faradai Coil has a contact in Moltharok who will deny everything.
plotHooks: Faradai Coil asks the party to protect a household member without revealing why.
A rival faction offers proof that Faradai Coil's public story is incomplete.

npcs.name: Keleo Briarvast
npcs.description:
Keleo Briarvast is calm, elegant, openly dangerous, and almost insultingly polite about how many ways she knows to end a conversation permanently. As a Firbolg, she carries Anubaldir’s quiet inheritance of hidden strength, endurance, and protective stewardship, but in Stormgullet that guardian instinct has hardened into territorial paranoia: her shop, her clients, and her secrets are all things she protects with lethal precision.
At the Velvet Armory, Keleo sells black-market blades, firearms, thundercoil weapons, warded ammunition, explosives, and discreet “problem-solving packages” to anyone with enough coin and enough nerve. Her work with the Brass Concordat makes her less a simple merchant and more a contingency planner for Virelport’s underworld, keeping private kill-ledgers on rivals, militia captains, informants, and anyone foolish enough to threaten her business while the province’s street-level corruption and transit politics keep everyone looking elsewhere.
npcs.settlementAndAncestryTexture: Stormgullet is a City in Virelport, under City-State League, with high danger, Partial forest, Beach and grass with water, Deep forest terrain. Local records favor Altruistic, Neutral, Cooperative, Honorable civic habits; common communities include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Elf — Wood Elf, Elf — Eladrin, Fey-Folk — Faerie. Firbolg reads through the Firbolg entry of the race compendium, within Giantkin and Powerful Humanoids, marked by Anubaldir. Firbolgs are gentle giantkin deeply connected to nature and forest magic. They often act as guardians of wild places and maintain peaceful, reclusive lifestyles. Table cues: Firbolg Magic, Hidden Step, Powerful Build, Speech of Beast and Leaf; starting tendency Altruistic - Chaotic - Combative - Honorable.
